platform: Frozen Dans1 build (High/16, seven sequential gates, 358 focused tests) · production preview 127.0.0.1:8096 at desktop 1280x800 and tablet 1024x768 · isolated Windows-native executable (WebView2, CDP 9281, not installed) at 2560x1370 · isolated agent-browser profiles · real providers gemini-3.8-flash (text) and gemini-2.5-flash-image (render) with the user-authorized key
summary: The tree carrying the eight assistant unlock tools (SC-12) was frozen, built on Dans1 and exercised on the production bundle and on the Windows-native executable. All seven build gates passed; the executable, installer and web artifacts are hash-verified and the served bundle carries the build id. The az4 regressions, the wireframe and the workbench journeys passed on both platforms. The five unlock journeys passed in production: a design edited by ID and renamed, Redburn page 2 calibrated, traced and approved for a named person, a pasted price book imported, DXF and IFC exported with hash receipts, and 'generate a real life view of this plan' delivered as an AI visualisation on the Render pane. Natively the same journeys passed except rendering, which refused with the documented message. The native app closed gracefully, so the verified-build pointer moves to 8e14ac427997.
